name: Haylou Solar Pro 1.43" AMOLED Calling Smart Watch
nameBn: হেইলো সোলার প্রো ১.৪৩" অ্যামোলেড কলিং স্মার্ট ওয়াচ
short: 1.43'' Ultra-Clear AMOLED Display, Bluetooth HD Calling, 100+ Sports Modes, IP68 Waterproof
shortBn: ১.৪৩ ইঞ্চি আল্ট্রা-ক্লিয়ার অ্যামোলেড ডিসপ্লে, ব্লুটুথ এইচডি কলিং, ১০০+ স্পোর্টস মোড, আইপি৬৮ ওয়াটারপ্রুফ
description: The Haylou Solar Pro sports an exquisite anti-scratch metallic rotating bezel, a vibrant 1.43-inch AMOLED high-res panel with Always-On Display (AOD). Features one-tap Bluetooth calling with noise cancellation microphone and military-grade durability.

specs.Calling: High-Definition Bluetooth Phone Calling with Dialpad
specs.Health Sensors: 24H Heart Rate, SpO2 Blood Oxygen, Sleep & Stress Monitor
specs.Battery: Up to 7 Days (Heavy Use), 20 Days (Basic Standby)

highlights: Retina grade 1.43" AMOLED with vivid color contrast
Direct clear wrist calling with phonebook sync
Robust metallic body built for daily grind

name: Amazfit Bip 5 Unity 1.91" Smart Watch with Zepp OS
short: Massive 1.91" Display, Zepp OS 3.0 App Ecosystem, 120+ Sports Modes & Bluetooth Calls
shortBn: বিশাল ১.৯১" ডিসপ্লে, জেপ ওএস ৩.০ অ্যাপস, ১২০+ স্পোর্টস মোড ও ব্লুটুথ কলিং
description: Super-sized 1.91-inch display with rich colors and responsive touch. Powered by modern Zepp OS 3.0 allowing downloadable mini apps and games. Stainless steel bezel delivers executive aesthetics with comprehensive biometric tracking.

specs.Battery: 300mAh, up to 11 days typical battery life
specs.Microphone & Speaker: Yes, Bluetooth calling & Alexa Voice Assistant
specs.Sports Tracking: 120+ Sports modes with auto workout detection

highlights: Downloadable smart apps via Zepp OS
